text: dsh-mobile-ui 是一个适用于 DSH Web 客户端的移动端设置面板样式插件。它通过 Web server 的 index 注入接口加入响应式 CSS，在屏幕宽度不超过 680 像素时把设置窗口铺满屏幕，将侧边导航改成顶部可横向滚动的标签栏，并把关闭按钮固定在右上方。插件还为内容区域和安全区留出空间，让通用设置行可以换行，便于在手机浏览器中查看和操作设置。它仅调整设置面板的布局，不提供新的设置功能；代码没有读取密钥或配置项，也没有声明外部服务。

dsh-mobile-ui adapts the DSH web settings panel for phones. It injects CSS through the web server index hook to make the panel full-screen on narrow screens, move navigation into a horizontal top tab bar, pin the close button, and let settings rows wrap. It needs no key or external service.
想让 DSH 网页里的设置面板在手机上更好操作。
手机浏览器打开设置时，能不能让面板铺满屏幕并保留容易点击的关闭按钮？
Make the DSH web settings panel easier to navigate on a narrow phone screen.
dsh-mobile-ui 的功能「手机端设置布局」：视口宽度不超过 680 像素时，将设置面板铺满屏幕，并把侧边导航改为顶部横向标签栏。插件自动通过 Web server 的页面注入生效。
dsh-mobile-ui 的功能「移动端面板细节」：小屏下将关闭按钮固定在右上方，为内容及设备安全区留出空间，并允许通用设置行换行。样式随页面自动注入，不需要单独命令或输入。

dsh-mobile-ui README · dsh-mobile-ui：English | [繁體中文](README_ZH.md)

Responsive CSS override plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) web settings panel.

dsh-mobile-ui README · What it does：On viewports ≤ 680px (mobile browsers), it:

- Turns the 800px-wide desktop settings modal into a **full-screen vertical sheet**.
- Converts the 188px left nav rail into a **full-width, horizontally scrollable tab bar** at the top.
- Pins the **close button** to the top-right corner.
- Makes the content area fill the remaining height with independent scrolling and safe-area padding.
- Lets General settings rows wrap instead of squeezing their controls off-screen.
dsh-mobile-ui README · What it does：Desktop / tablet (>680px) is unaffected.

dsh-mobile-ui README · From GitHub：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add -w https://github.com/jackuh105/dsh-mobile-ui.git
```

dsh-mobile-ui README · From a local checkout：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/jackuh105/dsh-mobile-ui.git
cd dsh-mobile-ui\..
dsh plugin --profile web add -w ./dsh-mobile-ui
```

`dsh plugin` automatically adds this package to the web profile's bundle list because it declares `dsh.bundle`.

Restart the web profile after installing:

```powershell
dsh web
```

If you access the web UI through a reverse proxy such as Tailscale, keep your existing startup flags (for example `--trusted-host`).

dsh-mobile-ui README · Verify：Open the browser developer tools and confirm the returned HTML `<head>` contains:

```html
<style id="dsh-mobile-ui">...</style>
```

Or narrow a desktop browser window below 680px and open the settings panel to see the layout change.

dsh-mobile-ui README · Uninstall：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mobile-ui
```

Then restart `dsh web` to restore the original layout.
dsh-mobile-ui README · Tweak：Edit the `CSS` string in `lib/index.js` (for example change the `680px` breakpoint), then restart `dsh web`.

dsh-mobile-ui README · Compatibility：The CSS selectors currently target the settings panel structure of dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`. If dsh is upgraded and its class names change, the selectors may need to be updated.

dsh-mobile-ui README · Troubleshooting：If `dsh plugin --profile web add` fails with `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT`, add `-w` before the package spec:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add -w https://github.com/jackuh105/dsh-mobile-ui.git
```

The dsh profile directory is a pnpm workspace root, and some pnpm versions require `-w` to install into it. `dsh plugin` forwards the flag verbatim to pnpm.
